in_marathi.name: Bijendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Conqueror of Bijas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bijendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bijendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Bija' (seed) and 'Indra' (god of thunder). The name means 'Conqueror of Bijas'. In Hindu mythology, Indra is the king of heaven and the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. The name Bijendra is believed to bring victory and success.
